concepts.name: small transformer
concepts.definition: A neural network model with a small architecture.

concepts.name: self attention
concepts.definition: A mechanism for processing text sequences by attending to relevant parts.

concepts.name: text
concepts.definition: Linguistic data in sequence form.

concepts.name: backpropagation
concepts.definition: An algorithm for updating model weights based on prediction errors.

concepts.name: predictions of the small transformer
concepts.definition: Output estimates generated by the small transformer.

concepts.name: training
concepts.definition: The phase where a model learns from data.

concepts.name: regularization
concepts.definition: A technique applied to models to improve generalization.

concepts.name: training examples of the small transformer
concepts.definition: The specific dataset instances used to train the small transformer model.

concepts.name: quantization
concepts.definition: A technique applied after training to reduce memory requirements.

concepts.name: memory requirements of the small transformer
concepts.definition: The amount of memory needed by the small transformer model.

concepts.name: retrieval augmented generation
concepts.definition: A method allowing the use of external documents during question answering.

concepts.name: external documents
concepts.definition: Documents used to support answers in retrieval-augmented generation.

concepts.name: token embeddings
concepts.definition: Numerical vectors representing individual words or subwords in a sequence.

concepts.name: contextual representations
concepts.definition: Vector representations of tokens that incorporate information from the entire input sequence.

concepts.name: prediction errors
concepts.definition: Discrepancies between predicted and actual values used to guide learning.

concepts.name: gradients
concepts.definition: Partial derivatives indicating the direction and magnitude for weight updates.

concepts.name: dropout
concepts.definition: A mechanism where random neurons are deactivated during training to prevent co-adaptation of features.

concepts.name: weight decay
concepts.definition: A mechanism that adds a penalty term to the loss function based on the magnitude of model parameters.

concepts.name: generalization
concepts.definition: The ability of a model to perform well on unseen data.

concepts.name: model complexity
concepts.definition: A measure of the number of parameters or their magnitudes in a model.

concepts.name: prevents overfitting
concepts.definition: The state or outcome achieved by forcing the network to learn redundant representations that are robust to the absence of specific neurons.

concepts.name: numerical precision of model weights
concepts.definition: The degree of accuracy with which numerical values are represented in a model.

concepts.name: document retrieval process
concepts.definition: A mechanism that initiates fetching relevant external documents based on a query.
